newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rhone-Poulenc sees income below forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Rhone-Poulenc sees income below forecasts.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc SA said on Thursday that its 1996 net income could fall six to seven percent below market expectations because of its Rhone-Poulenc Rorer unit's recall of its albumin products.

"The 1996 net income of Rhone-Poulenc SA, which holds 68 percent of Rhone-Poulenc Rorer, could be affected by a fall in the order of six to seven percent of the net income expected by the financial market," the company said in a statement.

Earlier on Thursday, Rhone-Poulenc Rorer said its 50 percent owned unit Centeon was voluntarily recalling all in-date lots of its Albuminar and Plasma Plex albumin products as a precaution against bacterial infection.
Rorer said this could cut its 1996 net income by 10 to 12 percent.
